premises.text: Car search in MENA has no centralized platform, inconsistent illegitimate information, and non-standardized pricing
premises.evidence_span: Finding a great deal is hard because there's no centralized platform, inconsistent and illegitimate information, and no standardized pricing in the MENA region

premises.text: AI prices cars from photos with continuous market recalibration and aggregates all national listings
premises.evidence_span: The AI behind the pricing even scans the market to constantly adjust its algorithm to make sure that it stays relevant with the market as it is currently

premises.text: Caesar chatbot negotiates with every dealer so buyers see final prices before choosing
premises.evidence_span: when he's ready to search, we will already have negotiated some cars so he can see what their final price is

premises.text: WhatsApp integration books seller contact and test drives
premises.evidence_span: with the help of our WhatsApp integration, he simply contacts the seller and books a test drive, all with the help of Sease

premises.text: Monetize via OEM/dealer leads, brand BI tools, and bank/insurance VAS partners
premises.evidence_span: We work with OEMs and certified dealers to send them leads on their featured cars

premises.text: Surface leasing options to grow MENA leasing from very low penetration
premises.evidence_span: you'll be able to lease cars through the C-SAP. So instead of just seeing new and used cars, you can also see the leasing options for these cars

value.text: Get the right car at the right time at the right price across buy and lease
value.evidence_span: get the right car, at the right time, at the right price
